summary: A 1975 note on the difference between early and later versions of FTP, arguing for leaving well enough alone. It is part of a discussion thread that includes RFC 691, RFC 640, RFC 630, RFC 542, RFC 454, RFC 448, RFC 414, RFC 385 and RFC 354.

eli5.summary: Two versions of a tool worked a little differently. This note says do not change what already works well enough.

questions: early ftp versus later ftp differences
